title: Munozarani boshqarish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ingliz tilida ochiq bahs va panelni professional boshqara olasiz: notiqlarni tanishtirish, vaqt va navbatlarni boshqarish, g‘oyalarni ulash va qisqacha xulosa qilish, qiyin ishtirokchilar bilan ishlash.

scenes.title: Munozarani boshqarish
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda ishontiruvchi ommaviy nutq so‘zlashni o‘rgandik. Bugun esa notiq emas, balki notiqlarni boshqaradigan odam — moderator bo‘lamiz: kun tartibini ochish, so‘z navbatini berish, vaqtni ushlab turish, g‘oyalarni ulash va qiyin ishtirokchilar bilan ishlash. O‘zbek tilida moderatorlik deyarli o‘rgatilmaydi, lekin ingliz tilidagi xalqaro konferensiyalarda moderator — sessiyaning yuragi. Dars oxirida uch kishilik panel uchun to‘liq moderatsiya skripti tuzasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson six. Today you become the moderator: introduce speakers, manage time and turns, bridge ideas, summarise, and handle difficult participants with grace.
scenes.say_uz: Oltinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. Bugun siz moderator bo‘lasiz: notiqlarni tanishtirasiz, vaqt va navbatlarni boshqarasiz, fikrlarni ulaysiz, xulosa qilasiz va qiyin ishtirokchilar bilan to‘g‘ri ishlaysiz.

scenes.title: Moderatorning roli: boshqarish, yo‘naltirish, yig‘in

examples.t: My job today is to keep us moving — not to talk the most.
examples.uz: Bugun mening vazifam — bizni oldinga harakatlantirish, eng ko‘p gapirish emas.

examples.t: Let’s set a few ground rules before we begin.
examples.uz: Boshlashdan oldin bir necha asosiy qoidani belgilab olaylik.

scenes.say_native: Ko‘pchilik moderatorlikni “eng moslashuvchan yoki eng mashhur odamni qo‘yish” deb o‘ylaydi — bu xato. Moderator ekspert emas, yo‘l ko‘rsatuvchi: u gapirmaydi, boshqaradi. Uchta mas’uliyat bor. Birinchisi — kun tartibi va qoidalar: vaqt, navbat, savol-javob tartibi. Ikkinchisi — energiya: muhokama muzlab qolsa — iliq, juda qizib ketsa — sekinlashtirish. Uchinchisi — inklyuzivlik: tinglovchini va jim panelistlarni ham eshittirish. Eslab qoling: yaxshi moderator suhbat oxirida ko‘rinmas, lekin muhokama izsiz, tuzilgan va jonli qoladi — “Invisible conductor” — ko‘rinmas dirijyor.
scenes.say: A moderator is not the expert — the guide. Set ground rules, manage energy, and make sure every voice is heard. Be the invisible conductor.
scenes.say_uz: Moderator ekspert emas — yo‘l ko‘rsatuvchi. Asosiy qoidalarni belgilang, energiyani boshqaring va har bir ovoz eshitilishini ta’minlang. Ko‘rinmas dirijyor bo‘ling.

scenes.title: Notiqlarni tanishtirish: nom, unvon, nega aynan u

examples.t: Please welcome Dr. Dilnoza Karimova, head of urban planning at the Ministry of Construction.
examples.uz: Xush kelibsiz, qurilish vazirligida shaharsozlik bo‘limining boshlig‘i, Dilnoza Karimova doktoriga.

examples.t: She has led three city master plans over the past decade.
examples.uz: U so‘nggi o‘n yilda uchta shahar bosh rejasini yetakchilik qilgan.

scenes.say_native: Tanishtirish — sessiyaning birinchi taassuroti. Ingliz tilida uch qatlam: birinchi — ism va lavozim — “Please welcome Dr. Dilnoza Karimova, head of urban planning at the Ministry of Construction” — iltimos, xush kelibsiz, qurilish vazirligining shaharsozlik bo‘limi boshlig‘i — unvon + tashkilot. Ikkinchi — bitta qatorli havola — nega aynan u — “She has led three city master plans” — u uchta shahar bosh rejasini boshqargan — ishonch yaratadi. Uchinchi — mavzu ulanishi — “She will speak on walkable cities” — u piyoda shaharlar haqida gapiradi. Hech qachon biografiyani to‘liq o‘qimang — ingliz auditoriya uzun tarjimai holni yoqtirmaydi. Eslab qoling: tanishtirish — ikki jumla, ismining to‘g‘ri talaffuzi — bu moderatorning professionalizmi sinovdan o‘tadi.
scenes.say: Introduce in three parts: name and role — please welcome Dr. Dilnoza Karimova — one-line credential — she has led three master plans — then the topic she will speak on. Two sentences, no more.
scenes.say_uz: Tanishtiruv uch qismdan iborat: ism va lavozim — “please welcome” — bir qatorli havola — “u uchta bosh rejani boshqargan” — keyin gapiradigan mavzusi. Ikki jumlta, boshqa emas.

scenes.title: Notiqni tanishtirish mashqi
scenes.say_native: Jasur Rahimov — IT kompaniyaning bosh texnologik direktori — mavzusi: sun’iy intellekt va mehnat bozori. Ingliz tilida ikki gapli tanishtirish yozing: birinchi gapda ism, lavozim, tashkilot — “Please welcome Jasur Rahimov, CTO of…”; ikkinchi gapda bitta havola — masalan, u 50 kishilik jamoani boshqaradi yoki 10 yillik tajribaga ega — siz tanlang — va mavzuga ulanish. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Write a two-sentence English introduction for Jasur Rahimov, CTO of an IT company, speaking on AI and jobs. Name, role, one credential, then the topic.
scenes.say_uz: IT kompaniyaning CTO’si Jasur Raimov uchun ingliz tilida ikki gapli tanishtirish yozing — mavzu: sun’iy intellekt va ish. Ism, lavozim, bitta havola, keyin mavzu.

scenes.title: Javoblar: tanishtirish mashqi
board: “Please welcome Jasur Rahimov, CTO of TechNova.”
“He will speak on AI and jobs.”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunasi: “Please welcome Jasur Rahimov, Chief Technology Officer at TechNova. He has scaled three engineering teams across Central Asia, and today he will ask whether AI creates more jobs than it destroys.” — birinchi gap — ism, lavozim, tashkilot; ikkinchi — havola va mavzu. Sizning matningizda tafsilotlar boshqacha bo‘ladi — muhimi ikki jumladan oshmaslik va ism talaffuzini tiniq aytish. Yodda tuting: tanishtirishda ismi xato aytilsa, butun sessiyaga ishonch yo‘qoladi.
scenes.say: Model: please welcome Jasur Rahimov, Chief Technology Officer at TechNova. He has scaled three engineering teams, and today he asks whether AI creates more jobs than it destroys.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: xush kelibsiz, TechNova bosh texnologik direktori Jasur Rahimov. U uchta muhandislik jamoasini kattalashtirgan, bugun esa u AI ish joylarini yaratadimi yoki yo‘qotadimi deb so‘raydi.

scenes.title: Sessiyani ochish: xush kelibsiz, qoidalar, reja

examples.t: A few ground rules: phones on silent, questions at the end, and we keep to time.
examples.uz: Bir necha asosiy qoida: telefonlar ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, vaqtni ushlab turamiz.

examples.t: Here is our plan: three speakers, then discussion, then Q&A.
examples.uz: Mana bizning reja: uchta notiq, keyin muhokama, keyin savol-javob.

scenes.say_native: Sessiya ochilishi uchta qisqa qatlamdan iborat. Birinchisi — xush kelibsiz va o‘zingizni tanishtirish: “Good afternoon, I’m…, and I’ll be moderating today” — xayrli kun, men …, bugun moderatorlik qilaman — 15 soniya. Ikkinchisi — asosiy qoidalar — ground rules — “phones on silent, questions at the end, please keep to time” — telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, vaqtga rioya qiling — uchta ibora yetarli. Uchinchisi — reja xaritasi — “Here is our plan: three speakers, discussion, Q&A” — reja ko‘rsatilsa, tinglovchi xotirjam bo‘ladi — rejasiz sessiya — yo‘qolgan sessiya. Eslab qoling: ochilish besh daqiqadan oshmasin — odamlar mavzu uchun keldi, xush kelibsiz uchun emas.
scenes.say: Open in three layers: welcome and your name, ground rules — phones silent, questions at the end — and the agenda: three speakers, discussion, Q&A. Under five minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Ochilishni uch qatlamda bering: xush kelibsiz va ismingiz, asosiy qoidalar — telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida — va reja: uchta notiq, muhokama, savol-javob. Besh daqiqadan oshirmang.

scenes.title: Vaqtni boshqarish: time cues va soft wrap
board: “In the interest of time…” — vaqt manfaati uchun

examples.t: You have about two minutes left.
examples.uz: Taxminan ikki daqiqa vaqtingiz qoldi.

examples.t: In the interest of time, let’s take one more point from each panelist.
examples.uz: Vaqt manfaati uchun, har bir panelistdan yana bitta fikr olaylik.

scenes.say_native: Vaqt — moderatorning eng qat’iy asbobi va eng muloyim iboralari. Ingliz tilida vaqt ishoralari: “You have about two minutes left” — taxminan ikki daqiqangiz qoldi — “about” — muloyim. O‘tish: “Let’s move on to…” — endi…ga o‘tamiz, “Turning now to…” — endi …ga murojaat qilamiz. Vaqtni tejash: “In the interest of time, one more point each” — vaqt manfaati uchun, har biriga bittadan — qattiq emas, professional. Sekinlashtirish kerak bo‘lsa: “That’s a rich point — let’s stay there for a moment” — bu boy fikr — bir oz ko‘proq to‘xtaylik. Eslab qoling: vaqt haqida ochiq ayting — jim tutsangiz, hamma chumoli uyiga kirib oladi.
scenes.say: Use time cues: about two minutes left; let’s move on to; in the interest of time; and when worth lingering, that is a rich point, let’s stay there.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt ishoralaridan foydalaning: taxminan ikki daqiqa qoldi; endi o‘tamiz; vaqt manfaati uchun; va kerak bo‘lsa — bu boy fikr, shu yerda biroz qolaylik.

scenes.title: Navbatni boshqarish: so‘z berish, to‘xtatish, jim panelistni uyg‘otish
board: Stop gently: “Let me pause you there…”
Invite quiet: “Sarah, you’ve been quiet — your view?”

examples.t: Let’s hear from Dilnoza — you wanted to add something.
examples.uz: Dilnoza, biz sizni tinglaymiz — siz nimadardir qo‘shmoqchi edingiz.

examples.t: Let me pause you there — we’ll come back to that.
examples.uz: Shu yerda to‘xtatib turaman — bunga qaytamiz.

scenes.say_native: Navbat — navbatma-navbat — lekin tabiiy ko‘rinadi. So‘z berish: “Let’s hear from Dilnoza” — Dilnozani tinglaymiz — yoki “Jasur, you wanted to add something” — Jasur, siz nimadardir qo‘shmoqchi edingiz. Ko‘p gapiradiganini muloyim to‘xtatish: “Let me pause you there — we’ll come back to that” — shu yerda to‘xtatib turaman — bunga qaytamiz — to‘xtatish + qaytish va’dasi — u o‘zini eshitilgandek his qiladi. Jim panelistni uyg‘otish: “Sarah, you’ve been quiet — what’s your view?” — Sara, siz jim o‘tirdingiz — fikringiz-chi? — chunki jim ovoz ham fikrdir. Keskin aralashadiganini so‘z kesish bilan boshqaring: “Let Dilnoza finish — then I’ll come straight to you.” — Dilnoza tugatib qo‘ysin — keyin sizga darhol kelaman. Eslab qoling: har bir kishi kamida bir marta gapsin — moderatorning muvaffaqiyati shu.
scenes.say: Give the floor: let’s hear from Dilnoza. Pause a dominant voice: let me pause you, we’ll come back. Invite the quiet: your view? And stop interruptions: let Dilnoza finish, then I’ll come to you.
scenes.say_uz: So‘z bering: Dilnozani tinglaylik. Ko‘p gapiradiganini to‘xtating: shu yerda to‘xtating, qaytamiz. Jim o‘tirganiga murojaat qiling: fikringiz? Va aralashishni to‘xtating: Dilnoza tugasin, keyin sizga kelaman.

scenes.title: Vaqt va navbat mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyatni ingliz tilida hal qiling. Birinchi: notiqqa vaqt tugashini ayting — “about two minutes” ishlatib — muloyim lekin aniq. Ikkinchi: panelist uchinchi marta o‘z fikriga qaytmoqda — uni to‘xtatib, qaytish va’dasi bilan — “Let me pause you there”. Uchinchi: bir panelist butun sessiyada biror og‘iz gapirmadi — unga shaxsiy murojaat qiling — ismi bilan. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Handle three moments in English: warn a speaker about two minutes left; gently stop a panelist repeating himself with a promise to return; invite a silent panelist by name.
scenes.say_uz: Uch lahzani ingliz tilida hal qiling: notiqqa ikki daqiqa qolganini ayting; takrorlayotgan panelistni muloyim to‘xtating va qaytish va’dasi bering; jim panelistga ismi bilan murojaat qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar: vaqt va navbat mashqi
board: “Let me pause you there — we’ll come back.”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Birinchi: “About two minutes left, Dilnoza” — ism qo‘shsangiz, shaxsiy va muloyim eshitiladi. Ikkinchi: “Let me pause you there — we’ll come back to it” — to‘xtatish va qaytish birga — u o‘zini hurmat qilingan his qiladi. Uchinchi: “Jasur, you’ve been quiet — I’d value your view” — mensinchilik va hurmat. Eslab qoling: moderatorning har bir gapi ismi bilan atalgan bo‘lsa — butun panel tinglaydi va hurmat qiladi.
scenes.say: Models: about two minutes left, Dilnoza; let me pause you there, we’ll come back to it; Jasur, you’ve been quiet — I’d value your view.
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar: Dilnoza, taxminan ikki daqiqa qoldi; shu yerda to‘xtatib turaman, bunga qaytamiz; Jasur, siz jim o‘tirdingiz — fikringiz men uchun qimmatli.

scenes.title: Yomon moderatorlik: nimalar qilinmaydi

examples.t: That’s a fair challenge — let’s put it to the panel.
examples.uz: Bu haqli chaqiriq — uni panelga qo‘yaylik.

examples.t: Great question — we’ll park it for the Q&A.
examples.uz: Yaxshi savol — savol-javobga qoldiramiz.

scenes.say_native: Yomon moderatorlikning uchta belgisi. Birinchisi — moderatorning o‘zi eng ko‘p gapirishi — u mehmon emas, boshlovchi — vaqt o‘tganini tinglovchi sezadi — to‘g‘risi: moderator gapining 80 foizi savol va ko‘rsatma. Ikkinchisi — qiyin savolni o‘tkazib yuborish — “Let’s skip that” — buni chetga suraylik — tinglovchini mensituv — to‘g‘risi: “That’s a fair challenge — let’s put it to the panel” — bu haqli chaqiriq — uni panelga qo‘yamiz — qiyinchilikni qabul qilib, panelga topshirish. Uchinchisi — muhokamani parcha-parcha qilish — har bir gapdan keyin o‘zingizga qaytib olish — to‘g‘risi: ulanishni tinglovchiga qoldiring. Eslab qoling: moderator — ko‘zgu, aktyor emas.
scenes.say: Never: out-talk the panel, skip the hard question, or hog the stage. Do: keep your share of talk under twenty per cent, park hard questions for Q&A, and reflect the room.
scenes.say_uz: Hech qachon: paneldan ko‘p gapirmang, qiyin savolni o‘tkazib yubormang, sahnani o‘zlashtirmang. Qiling: o‘zingizning ulushiyingizni yigirma foizdan kam ushlang, qiyin savolni FAQ-ga qoldiring, zaldagi fikrlarni akslantiring.

scenes.title: Bridging: fikrlarni ulash va ko‘prik iboralar

examples.t: That connects with what Dilnoza said about walkability.
examples.uz: Bu Dilnoza aytgan piyoda yurish qulayligi haqidagi fikrga ulanadi.

examples.t: Building on that, what about rural areas?
examples.uz: Shundan kelib chiqib, qishloq hududlar-chi?

scenes.say_native: Bridging — ulanish — moderatorning eng nafis mahorati. Panelistlar alohida gaplarni aytadi — moderator ularni hikoyaga aylantiradi. Uchta ko‘prik iborasi: birinchisi — bog‘lash: “That connects with what Dilnoza said about walkability” — bu Dilnoza aytgan piyoda yurish qulayligi mavzusiga ulanadi — fikrni oldingisiga bog‘lang. Ikkinchisi — oldinga siljitish: “Building on that, what about rural areas?” — shundan kelib chiqib — qishloq hududlari-chi? — mavzuni chuqurlashtiring. Uchinchisi — qarshi tomonga o‘tish: “Interesting — now the other side of the argument” — qiziq — endi bahsning boshqa tomoni — qarama-qarshi fikrni chaqiring. Eslab qoling: bridging — panelni bitta yaxlit munozaraga aylantiradi, alohida monologlar emas.
scenes.say: Bridging turns separate talks into one conversation: that connects with what Dilnoza said, building on that, and interesting — now the other side of the argument.
scenes.say_uz: Bridging bir-biridan ajralgan gaplarni yagona suhbatga aylantiradi: bu Dilnoza aytganiga ulanadi, shundan kelib chiqib, va qiziq — endi bahsning boshqa tomoni.

scenes.title: Summarising: qisqacha xulosa qilish va tasdiqlash

examples.t: So if I understand correctly, you’re arguing for pilot zones first.
examples.uz: To‘g‘ri tushunganim bo‘lsa, siz avval sinov zonalarini taklif qilyapsiz.

examples.t: To summarise: cost, feasibility, then public support.
examples.uz: Xulosa qilsak: xarajat, amaliyot, keyin jamoatchilik qo‘llovi.

scenes.say_native: Summarising — qisqacha xulosa — muhokamani ramkaga soladi. Uchta qadam. Birinchisi — o‘z so‘zlaringiz bilan qaytarish: “So if I understand correctly, you’re arguing for pilot zones first” — to‘g‘ri tushunganim bo‘lsa — siz avval sinov zonalarini taklif qilyapsiz — paraphrase. Ikkinchisi — tasdiqlash: “Is that a fair summary?” — bu adolatli xulosami? — panelist “ha” deydi yoki to‘g‘rilaydi. Uchinchisi — belgilash: “To summarise: cost, feasibility, public support” — xulosa: xarajat, amaliyot, jamoatchilik qo‘llovi — uch so‘zli ramka. Eslab qoling: summarising — har 10-15 daqiqada bir marta — muhokama tarqoqlanishiga yo‘l qo‘ymang.
scenes.say: Summarise in three steps: paraphrase — so if I understand correctly; confirm — is that a fair summary; label — to summarise: cost, feasibility, public support. Do it every ten to fifteen minutes.
scenes.say_uz: Xulosa uch qadamda: paraphrase — to‘g‘ri tushunganim bo‘lsa; tasdiqlash — bu adolatli xulosami; belgilash — xulosa: xarajat, amaliyot, qo‘llov. Har o‘n-o‘n besh daqiqada bir marta qiling.

scenes.title: Bridging va summarising mashqi
scenes.say_native: Mavzu: shahar transporti. Birinchi: panelist “velosiped yo‘laklari” haqida gapirdi — Dilnoza “narx”ni tilga olgan bo‘lsin — ulanish gapi yozing — “That connects with…”. Ikkinchi: bahsning qarama-qarshi tomonini chaqiring — “Interesting — now…”. Uchinchi: ikki fikrni bitta jumltaga yig‘ing va tasdiqlang — “So, if I understand correctly…”. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Topic: city transport. Bridge from a cycling-lanes comment to an earlier cost point; invite the other side of the argument; then summarise both in one sentence and ask for confirmation.
scenes.say_uz: Mavzu: shahar transporti. Velosiped yo‘lagi haqidagi gapni oldinroq tilga olingan narx mavzusiga ulang; bahsning boshqa tomonini chaqiring; keyin ikkalasini bitta jumltaga yig‘ib tasdiqlang.

scenes.title: Javoblar: bridging va summarising
board: “That connects with Dilnoza’s point on cost…”
“So, if I understand correctly — lanes are viable if phased. Is that fair?”
scenes.say_native: Javob namunalari. Ko‘prik: “That connects with Dilnoza’s point on cost — do the lanes pay for themselves?” — Dilnozaning narx haqidagi gapiga ulanadi — yo‘laklar o‘zini oqlaydimi? — mavzu kengaydi. Qarama-qarshi tomon: “Interesting — now the other side: what about small businesses on those roads?” — qiziq — endi boshqa tomon: o‘sha yo‘llardagi kichik biznes-chi? — ikki tomonlama bahs. Xulosa: “So, if I understand correctly — the lanes are viable if phased gradually. Is that a fair summary?” — to‘g‘ri tushunganim bo‘lsa — bosqichma-bosqich bo‘lsa yo‘laklar mumkin. Bu adolatli xulosami? — paraphrase + tasdiqlash. Uchchala ko‘nikma birga ishlaydi.
scenes.say: Models: that connects with Dilnoza’s point on cost; interesting — now the other side, what about small businesses; so if I understand correctly, viable if phased — is that a fair summary?
scenes.say_uz: Namunalar: bu Dilnozaning narx haqidagi gapiga ulanadi; qiziq — endi boshqa tomon — kichik biznes-chi; to‘g‘ri tushunganim bo‘lsa — bosqichma-bosqich bo‘lsa mumkin — bu adolatli xulosami?

scenes.title: Qiyin ishtirokchilar: to‘rt tur va javoblar

examples.t: I hear the frustration — and we’ll give it real time in Q&A.
examples.uz: G‘azabingizni eshitaman — savol-javobda unga to‘liq vaqt beramiz.

examples.t: In thirty seconds — what’s the one thing you want us to take away?
examples.uz: O‘ttiz soniyada — bizga qoldirishni xohlagan bitta narsa nima?

scenes.say_native: To‘rt qiyin tur. Birinchisi — to‘xtatib turuvchi — “Let Dilnoza finish — then straight to you” — Dilnoza tugasin — keyin darhol sizga — qoida: navbatlar himoyalanadi. Ikkinchisi — ko‘p gapiradigan — “In thirty seconds — the one thing?” — o‘ttiz soniyada — bitta narsa — vaqt chegarasi yumshoq lekin aniq. Uchinchisi — tajovuzkor — avval acknowledge — “I hear the frustration” — g‘azabingizni eshitaman — keyin redirect — “let’s put it to the panel” — uni panelga qo‘yamiz — shaxsiy hujumga shaxsiy javob qaytarmang. To‘rtinchisi — jim — ismi bilan chaqiring — “Jasur, you haven’t spoken — what’s your view?” — hurmat bilan. Eslab qoling: qiyin odam — muammo emas, signal — moderatorning ishini ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Four difficult types: the interrupter — let them finish first; the long-winded — thirty seconds, one thing; the aggressive — acknowledge, redirect to the panel; the silent — ask by name.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rt qiyin tur: aralashadigan — avval tugasin; ko‘p gapiradigan — o‘ttiz soniya, bitta narsa; tajovuzkor — e’tirof eting, panelga yo‘naltiring; jim — ismi bilan so‘rang.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 1: panelning ochilish daqiqalari
board: “Ground rules: phones silent, questions at the end.”
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — panelning ochilish daqiqalari. Moderator: “Good afternoon, I’m Aziza from the Urban Forum, and I’ll be moderating today. Three ground rules: phones on silent, questions at the end, concise answers. Here is our plan: three speakers, discussion, Q&A.” — xayrli kun, men Urban Forumdan Azizaman. Uchta asosiy qoida: telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, javoblar qisqa. Rejamiz: uchta notiq, muhokama, keyin savol-javob. Keyin tanishtiruv: “Please welcome Dr. Dilnoza Karimova — she has led three master plans and will speak on fifteen-minute cities.” — xush kelibsiz, Dilnoza Karimova — uchta bosh reja yetakchisi — bugun o‘n besh daqiqalik shaharlar haqida.
scenes.say: Good afternoon, I’m Aziza from the Urban Forum. Three ground rules: phones silent, questions at the end, concise answers. Here is our plan: three speakers, discussion, Q&A. Please welcome Dr. Dilnoza Karimova, head of urban planning — she has led three master plans and will speak on fifteen-minute cities.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli kun, men Urban Forumdan Azizaman. Uchta asosiy qoida: telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, javoblar qisqa. Rejamiz: uchta notiq, muhokama, savol-javob. Xush kelibsiz, qurilish vazirligining shaharsozlik boshlig‘i Dilnoza Karimova — u uchta bosh rejani boshqargan va bugun o‘n besh daqiqalik shaharlar haqida gapiradi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: moderator o‘zini qanday tanishtiradi — ismi va tashkiloti? Ikkinchi: uchta asosiy qoida qanday ataladi? Uchinchi: sessiya rejasi qanday ketma-ketlikda? To‘rtinchi: Dilnoza Karimovaning qaysi havolasi aytiladi — nechta master plan? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: who is the moderator and from where, what are the three ground rules, what is the agenda order, and which credential of Dilnoza Karimova is mentioned?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: moderator kim va qayerdan, uchta asosiy qoida nima, reja qanday tartibda va Dilnoza Karimovaning qaysi havolasi tilga olinadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
board: Telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, qisqa javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Moderator — Aziza, Urban Forumdan. Uch qoida: telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, javoblar qisqa. Reja: notiqlar — muhokama — savol-javob. Dilnoza Karimovaning havolasi: u uchta shahar bosh rejasini boshqargan. Qisqa, aniq, tartibli — ochilish aynan shunday bo‘lishi kerak. Sizning sessiyangiz ham xuddi shu skeletda boshlanadi.
scenes.say: Answers: Aziza from the Urban Forum; phones silent, questions at the end, concise answers; speakers, discussion, Q&A; and she has led three master plans.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: Aziza, Urban Forumdan; telefon ovozsiz, savollar oxirida, javoblar qisqa; notiqlar, muhokama, savol-javob; va u uchta master planni boshqargan.

scenes.title: TINGLANG 2: tajovuzkor panelist bilan ishlash
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — tajovuzkor panelist bilan. Panelist: “This whole plan is nonsense — experts never know our streets!” — bu butun reja bema’ni. Moderator, tinch: “I hear the frustration — that’s a fair challenge. Dilnoza, how would you answer that?” — g‘azabingizni eshitaman — Dilnoza, bunga qanday javob berasiz? Dilnoza: “Fair point — that’s why every master plan starts with community walks.” — to‘g‘ri nuqta — shuning uchun bosh rejalar mahalla yurishlaridan boshlanadi. Moderator: “There you have it. In the interest of time, one more question from each panelist — then we’ll open the floor.” — mana shuni oldingiz. Vaqt manfaati uchun, har bir panelistdan yana bittadan — keyin zal savollariga ochamiz.
scenes.say: This whole plan is nonsense — experts never know our streets! I hear the frustration — that is a fair challenge. Dilnoza, how would you answer that? Fair point — that is why plans start with community walks. There you have it. In the interest of time, one more question each — then we open the floor.
scenes.say_uz: Bu butun reja bema’ni — mutaxassislar ko‘chalarimizni hech qachon bilmaydi! G‘azabingizni eshitaman — bu haqli chaqiriq. Dilnoza, bunga qanday javob berasiz? To‘g‘ri nuqta — shuning uchun rejalar mahalla yurishlaridan boshlanadi. Mana shuni oldingiz. Vaqt manfaati uchun, har biridan yana bittadan — keyin zal savollariga ochamiz.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: tajovuzkor panelist nima dedi — qaysi so‘zlarni ishlatdi? Ikkinchi: moderator birinchi navbatda nima qildi — shaxsiy emas, qanday javob berdi? Uchinchi: Dilnoza qanday javob berdi — qaysi yechim bilan? To‘rtinchi: “In the interest of time” iborasi keyin nima qilishga chaqirdi? Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: Answer: what did the panelist say, what did the moderator do first, how did Dilnoza respond, and what does in the interest of time lead into?
scenes.say_uz: Javob bering: panelist nima dedi, moderator birinchi nima qildi, Dilnoza qanday javob berdi va “in the interest of time” nimani boshlaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Panelist: “This whole plan is nonsense” — tajovuzkor, lekin haqiqiy g‘azab. Moderator birinchi qadam: e’tirof — “I hear the frustration” — keyin chaqiriqni panelga topshirdi. Dilnozaning javobi: “community walks, street by street” — har bir ko‘cha bo‘ylab yurish — amaliy yechim. “In the interest of time” bilan moderator savol-javobga ochiq e’lon qildi. Uchchala qadam — e’tirof, yo‘naltirish, harakatlanish — qiyin ishtirokchi bilan ishlashning to‘liq modeli.
scenes.say: Answers: he called the plan nonsense; she acknowledged the frustration first, then redirected to Dilnoza; Dilnoza answered with community walks; and in the interest of time opened Q&A.
scenes.say_uz: Javoblar: u rejani bema’ni dedi; moderator avval g‘azabni e’tirof etdi, keyin panelga yo‘naltirdi; Dilnoza mahalla yurishlari bilan javob berdi; va in the interest of time savol-javobga ochdi.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: uch kishilik panel skripti
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. “Yoshlar va mehnat bozori” mavzusida uch kishilik panel uchun moderatsiya skripti yozing: ochilish (ismingiz, qoidalar, reja), uchta tanishtirish (Har biri ikki jumlta), har bir panelistga bittadan boshlang‘ich savol, vaqt ishorasi va yakun — “Thank you to our panel — and to you for a great discussion”. Skriptda kamida ikkita bridging iborasi va bitta summarising bo‘lsin. Keyin ingliz tilida baland ovozda ochilishni ayting.
scenes.say: Final task: script a three-person panel on youth and the labour market — opening, three two-sentence introductions, one opening question per panelist, time cues, a bridge, a summary, and a closing thank-you.
scenes.say_uz: Yakuniy vazifa: “yoshlar va mehnat bozori” bo‘yicha uch kishilik panel skripti yozing — ochilish, uchta ikki gapli tanishtirish, har biriga bitta boshlang‘ich savol, vaqt ishoralari, bridging, summarising va minnatdorchilik yakuni.

scenes.title: Namuna moderatsiya skripti parchasi

examples.t: Thank you all — let’s keep the energy and start with Dilnoza.
examples.uz: Hammaga rahmat — energiyani saqlagan holda Dilnozadan boshlaymiz.

scenes.say_native: Namuna skriptini ko‘ring: “Good afternoon, I’m Aziza, moderating. Ground rules: phones silent, questions at the end, concise answers — here’s our plan: three speakers on youth and jobs, discussion, then Q&A. Please welcome Dilnoza Karimova, head of urban planning — she’s led three master plans and will speak on fifteen-minute cities. Dilnoza — first question for you: whose city is the fifteen-minute city for?” — mana — ochilish, tanishtirish, savol — panel boshlandi. Video suhbatda har bir savol shu juftlikda — tanishtirish va savol — ulanib turadi. Yakunda: “Thank you to our panelists — and to all of you for a sharp discussion. The session will be shared with notes shortly.” — panelistlarga rahmat — sizlarga ham o‘tkir muhokama uchun — sessiya qisqa vaqt ichida yozuvlari bilan tarqatiladi.
scenes.say: Sample: ground rules, the plan, please welcome Dilnoza Karimova — she has led three master plans — Dilnoza, your first question: whose city is the fifteen-minute city for? And a warm close: thank you all.
scenes.say_uz: Namuna: asosiy qoidalar, reja, xush kelibsiz, Dilnoza Karimova — u uchta master planni boshqargan — Dilnoza, birinchi savolingiz: o‘n besh daqiqalik shahar kimning shahri? Va iliq yakun: hammaga rahmat.

scenes.title: Sessiyani yopish: rahmat, xulosa, keyingi qadamlar

examples.t: Thank you, Dilnoza, Jasur and Sarah — and thank you all for your questions.
examples.uz: Dilnoza, Jasur va Saraga rahmat — va savollaringiz uchun sizlarga ham rahmat.

examples.t: The recording and notes will be circulated this week.
examples.uz: Yozuv va xulosalar shu hafta tarqatiladi.

scenes.say_native: Yopishda uch qadam. Birinchisi — panelistlarga ismi bilan rahmat ayting: “Thank you, Dilnoza, Jasur and Sarah” — nomlash hurmat — umumiy rahmat zaifroq. Ikkinchisi — bitta jumlta takeaway — uch so‘z yoki bir ibora: “The message today: cities for people, phased and together” — bugungi xabar: shaharlar odamlar uchun — bosqichma-bosqich va birga — tinglovchi bittasini eslab qoladi. Uchinchisi — keyingi qadamlar: “The recording and notes will be circulated this week” — yozuv va xulosalar shu hafta tarqatiladi — va “Next session: affordable housing — same time next month” — keyingi sessiya: arzon uy-joy — keyingi oy ayni vaqtda. Eslab qoling: kuchli yopish — sessiyaning qiymatini ikki baravar oshiradi.
scenes.say: Close with three steps: thank each panelist by name, give one takeaway line, and say what happens next — recording, notes and the next session.
scenes.say_uz: Yopishni uch qadamda bering: har bir panelistga ismini aytib rahmat, bitta takeaway jumlta va keyingisi — yozuv, xulosalar va keyingi sessiya.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Moderatorning rolini — ko‘rinmas dirijyor; ochilishni — qoidalar va reja bilan; notiqlarni tanishtirishni — ism, lavozim, bitta havola; vaqt va navbatlarni — time cues va so‘z berish; bridging va summarising — fikrlarni ulash va xulosa; qiyin ishtirokchilarni — e’tirof, yo‘naltirish, ism bilan murojaat. Endi siz sessiyani nafaqat kuzata olasiz, balki boshqara olasiz.
scenes.say: Today you learned the moderator’s craft: openings and ground rules, introducing speakers, time and turn management, bridging and summarising, and handling difficult participants.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun moderatorlik mahoratini o‘rgandingiz: ochilish va qoidalar, notiqlarni tanishtirish, vaqt va navbatlarni boshqarish, bridging va summarising, hamda qiyin ishtirokchilar bilan ishlash.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Do‘stlaringiz bilan yoki o‘zingiz uch role o‘ynab, uch kishilik soxta panelni yozib oling — 10 daqiqa — to‘liq sikl: ochilish, tanishtirish, savollar, vaqt ishorasi, bridging, summarising, yopish. Yozib olishni qayta tinglang va öz baholaringizni bering — qaysi qism eng tabiiy edi? Keyingi darsda ilmiy maqola o‘qishni o‘rganamiz — ingliz tilidagi akademik matnlar bilan ishlash. Goodbye!
scenes.say: Homework: record a ten-minute mock three-person panel — full cycle from opening to close — and review it yourself. Next lesson: reading academic articles. Goodbye!
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifa: uch kishilik soxta panelni o‘n daqiqaga yozib oling — ochilishdan yopishgacha — va o‘zingiz baholang. Keyingi dars: ilmiy maqola o‘qish. Xayr!

homework_uz: Do‘stlaringiz bilan yoki uchta rol o‘ynab, uch kishilik soxta panelni 10 daqiqaga ingliz tilida yozib oling — ochilish, tanishtirish, vaqt ishoralari, bridging, summarising va yopish bilan — va o‘zingiz baholang. Keyingi dars: Ilmiy maqola o‘qish.

quiz.q: “In the interest of time” nimani bildiradi?

quiz.why_uz: Ism bilan murojaat — hurmat va ishtirok.
O‘z so‘zingiz bilan qaytaring, tasdiqlang, ramkalang.
Avval tan olish, keyin panelga yo‘naltirish.

quiz.q: Moderator o‘z ulushini qancha ushlashi kerak?
quiz.why_uz: Moderatorning gapi — savol va ko‘rsatmalar xolos.

options: panelistlarga ismi bilan rahmat + bitta takeaway
quiz.why_uz: Ism bilan minnatdorchilik va bitta esda qoladigan xabar.
